name: jev-route
description: Routes each turn to the cheapest capable Claude model using Jev, TypeSafe's decision model. Toggle with /route.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where to reach Jev: typesafe (api.typesafe.ai), gateway (Vercel AI Gateway) or custom (set jev_base_url).

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: TypeSafe API key, or Vercel AI Gateway key when provider is gateway. Stored in secure storage.

jev_base_url.title: Jev base URL
jev_base_url.description: Override the API base URL (no trailing slash). Empty derives it from provider; required for provider=custom.

jev_model.title: Jev model id
jev_model.description: Model id sent to the Jev endpoint.

model_fast.title: Model for fast tier
model_fast.description: Model id or alias used for trivial prompts.

model_balanced.title: Model for balanced tier
model_balanced.description: Model id or alias used for everyday coding prompts.

model_powerful.title: Model for powerful tier
model_powerful.description: Model id or alias used for hard or risky prompts.

upgrade_confidence.title: Upgrade confidence
upgrade_confidence.description: Minimum Jev confidence (0-1) to move a turn to a more capable tier than the current model (the one the previous turn ran on).

downgrade_confidence.title: Downgrade confidence
downgrade_confidence.description: Minimum Jev confidence (0-1) to move a turn to a cheaper tier than the current model, including back from a routed model to the session model. Blocked past switch_lock_tokens.

switch_lock_tokens.title: Switch lock (tokens)
switch_lock_tokens.description: Once the conversation context reaches this many tokens, turns stay on the current model unless risky: a cold prompt-cache write on a cheaper model costs more than the turn saves. 0 disables the lock.

timeout_ms.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Hard budget for the Jev call (50-5000); on timeout the session model is kept.

route_effort.title: Route effort too
route_effort.description: When a turn is moved to another model, also pin that model's effort (balanced=medium, powerful=high; haiku takes none). Effort is never changed on a kept model, since that would invalidate its prompt cache.

fallback_classifier.title: Built-in fallback classifier
fallback_classifier.description: When no API key is set, classify with Claude Code's built-in small-model classifier instead.

log_decisions.title: Log decisions
log_decisions.description: Show a toast with each routing decision (tier, confidence, latency) and, when the turn completes, its context size and cache hit rate.
